evidence_boundary: Synthetic experiments and external primary evidence only; no H1/H2/H3 target-runtime promotion.

clayresearch.delta: Integrated synthesis favors preserving ClayCode G9 surface semantics and converging compiler internals on a typed Causal Transition Kernel (CTK): epoch + delta + typed relation/roles + provenance + effect/capability/flow + measurement/intervention + cost/receipt. This is a lowering/implementation hypothesis, not a new user-facing language generation.
clayresearch.next_test: Attempt one executable semantic witness per registered branch against existing G9. Add surface syntax only if a witness cannot lower without an opaque host escape hatch.

frank.delta: The loop-of-loops view remains compatible with CTK if each recurrent update binds timescale, epoch, cause, intervention handle and verified outcome/re-entry. No evidence supports collapsing functional distinctions merely because H3 may collapse process boundaries.
frank.next_test: Provide minimal FRANK state-transition witnesses for goal coalition, body/world update, Needle effect intent, recovery and multi-timescale loop control for the BASE conformance suite.

gwt.delta: Toy re-entry test supports the contract distinction between truthful provenance-bound re-entry and shuffled extra context: mean MSE 0.1044 truthful vs 0.3005 shuffled over 200 seeds. This is synthetic support only.
gwt.next_test: Encode WorkspaceEpisode + delivery/reconstruction/uptake/use/outcome/re-entry as ClayCode witness and later replicate truthful/shuffled/none under H1 frozen model output.

emergenz.delta: Factorial interaction remains interaction evidence only. The Safe-Effect composition test produced Omega=1, illustrating how higher-order interaction can be real without implying consciousness or even beneficial emergence. PEID/PID readouts must remain estimator/intervention-bound.
emergenz.next_test: Use the same intervention-spec/receipt substrate for beneficial and harmful interaction tests; compare interaction-only conclusions against lesion/rescue/shuffle controls.

claycode.delta: Do not redesign G9 surface semantics absent executable counterexample. Investigate CTK as compiler-internal canonical transition IR and add composition-sensitive information-flow checks beside effect/capability checks. Add adaptive incremental-vs-batch thresholding instead of assuming delta propagation is always cheaper.
claycode.next_test: Build cross-branch executable semantic conformance suite first; implement CTK only if it reduces duplicated lowering/validation with semantic parity.

hyperposition.delta: Unlabeled pairwise reduction is constructively insufficient for ternary role identity: 6 role assignments collapsed to one clique. However typed role-labelled pairwise/state-machine reduction remains a live simpler alternative, so native n-ary representation should be justified by reduction/intervention error rather than ideology.
hyperposition.next_test: Compare native hyperrelation vs typed pairwise reduction on role shuffle, edge/hyperedge lesion, replay divergence and cost.

claygraph.delta: Dynamic projection should use dependency-directed invalidation when sparse but must support measured fallback because synthetic DAG closure touched ~9% at mean parent count 1 and ~92% at mean parent count 8. Activation remains derived/non-authoritative.
claygraph.next_test: Benchmark actual ClayGraph operators across sparse/dense mutation and choose incremental/batch crossover from measured cost, not fixed doctrine.

unifieddb.delta: Atomic semantic epoch publication remains a strong correctness candidate. Toy two-field interleaving produced ~33.4% mixed snapshots without atomic publication and 0% under modeled old-or-new epoch visibility. SQLite WAL/snapshot isolation provides external feasibility analogy, not proof of multi-store UDB design.
unifieddb.next_test: Implement/query an epoch-bound view contract and measure mixed-view errors, contention, p95 read latency and crash/replay across authoritative state plus derived sidecars.

harness.delta: Five discriminating tests are now defined and partially prototyped synthetically: truthful/shuffled re-entry, n-ary reduction, incremental-density crossover, capability composition, epoch coherence. H1 later becomes the target-runtime replication oracle; this run does not claim H1 execution.
harness.next_test: Convert these into reproducible BASE/H1 fixtures when gates permit, preserving frozen model outputs and exact intervention receipts.

global_cross_branch_delta: Use one typed transition/receipt substrate where it removes implementation duplication, but preserve epistemic, authority, graph, workspace and persistence distinctions. Semantic unification is not physical collapse.
stage_impact: NO_PASS_CREDIT. Research sharpens BASE acceptance/conformance and identifies implementation tests; all 14 current BASE work packages remain OPEN at last reread.
